Additional Training Programs

Specialized Market & Certification Programs

Alongside our flagship Equity Research Internship Program, Harion Research offers focused programs in portfolio management principles and NISM Series VIII exam preparation.

01 / Portfolio Construction & Risk

Portfolio Manager Internship Program

Learn how professional portfolio managers construct, monitor and rebalance multi-asset and equity portfolios using a disciplined, data-driven process on historical datasets.

MODULE 01

Portfolio construction & allocation

Structure portfolios by risk profile, investment horizon and diversification across sectors and instruments.

MODULE 02

Risk management & drawdown control

Position sizing, sector concentration limits and downside risk evaluation to protect capital across market phases.

MODULE 03

Performance attribution & tracking

Measuring CAGR, volatility, maximum drawdown and risk-adjusted metrics against benchmark indices.

MODULE 04

Market regimes & rebalancing

How portfolios behave across trending, range-bound and volatile regimes, and rule-based rebalancing frameworks.

Who this is for

  • Students of finance, economics or management building asset-allocation skills.
  • Aspiring wealth management, family office and investment research professionals.
  • CFA and NISM candidates seeking structured case-study assignments (allocation plans, risk sheets and performance review reports).

02 / Certification Coaching

NISM Series VIII Preparation

Structured 30-day exam coaching focused on passing the NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives Certification Examination on your first attempt.

UNIT 01

Derivatives basics & index concepts

Market participants, spot vs. derivatives markets, contract specifications, lot sizes and expiry cycles.

UNIT 02

Futures pricing & hedging

Cost-of-carry model, basis, mark-to-market margins, payoff diagrams and hedging mechanics.

UNIT 03

Options & the Greeks

Call and put payoffs, moneyness, intrinsic and time value, Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega and option spreads.

UNIT 04

Clearing, settlement & regulation

SPAN and exposure margins, clearing corporation role, SEBI regulatory framework, accounting and investor protection.

Who this is for

  • Students targeting roles in broking, wealth management, BFSI or capital markets operations where NISM VIII is mandatory.
  • Candidates retaking NISM Series VIII who want timed mock tests and negative-marking strategy review.
  • Note: This is certification exam coaching, not a speculative trading course. Equity Research Internship alumni receive ₹500 off.
